notes: Formulation A. Ten meaning units: Anton sails across the strait / the wind blows from the north / the waves strike the hull / Anton holds the wheel / a fishing boat crosses his course / the lighthouse appears / a seagull follows the boat / Anton checks the sails / the current pushes the boat south / Anton reaches the harbour. Subjects alternate between the protagonist (Anton), other agents (a fishing boat, a seagull) and natural objects (the wind, the waves, the lighthouse, the current), singular and plural, so C3 switches cross real subject-verb agreement; units 2 and 6 have bare intransitive predicates (blows/weht, appears/erscheint). No separable German verbs ('vorbeifahren', 'auftauchen', 'ankommen' avoided). 'Anton' is the only proper name. Present tense and positive polarity throughout; unit 9 reads naturally in German, units 1 and 10 in English.
